metadata.title: Waitan Roundtable: Dare You Hand the Wallet to an Agent?
metadata.guest: Han Xinyi · Jorn Lambert · Liu Zuohu · Zhou Jingren
metadata.guest_role: Ant CEO · Mastercard CPO · OPPO CPO · Alibaba chief scientist

conclusion: Waitan table: Ant CEO Han, Mastercard CPO Jorn Lambert, OPPO's Liu Zuohu, Alibaba scientist Zhou Jingren. Two rails — finish a human task, or machine-to-machine pay. Only Han has paid: ~40 yuan of snacks via 阿福. The others browse and stop at the card. Xiaobu purchases roughly doubled off a small base. Merchants and users wait on each other. Ant tries to be the catalyst. Jorn ships KYA — Know Your Agent — the same afternoon. Trust, not model IQ, is the gate.
background: Fireside 265, recorded on stage at 外滩大会. Hongjun's title: when the agent is the transacting principal. English from Jorn is dubbed. Han's 6–12 month 'agent economy' line is from a prior Alipay event; he has not seen it in Ant's backend yet — only in merchant conversations.
important_facts: Who has paid: Han, last week, ~40 yuan of healthy snacks on 阿福. Jorn uses AI to shop and will not let it charge — the rails are still e-commerce (user PAN or merchant subscription). Zhou is in the same 'decide with the model, pay yourself' camp. Liu used Xiaobu to collect Ant forest energy; Xiaobu GMV roughly 2x versus a few months ago, small base. Hongjun jokes she is the only 25% who has closed. The tape is dated 2026; treat every cap and percent as of the recording, not as a 2027 model.

Chicken and egg: users want agents; merchants will not staff an agent SKU without users. Han says 2025Q4 everyone was bullish on agentic commerce and 2026 landed slower. Ant's catalyst: a wish wall plus incentives so developers build what users asked for. Mastercard's Superbloom language is the other growth metaphor. The fix is standards, not another chat model.

Trust stack: Jorn compares it to the first time you typed a card into a website. Chargebacks trained the public. Now they need KYA (know your agent), intent confirm, and a global rulebook so a bad agent is the network's problem. He will publish KYA the same afternoon and says China already runs a more digital economy. Liu: the phone agent is an assistant; trust is the hard product. Zhou is still on the decision side of the funnel, not the settlement side.

mental_model.name: Human Task Rail × Machine Rail × KYA Trust
mental_model.components: Two products: finish my coffee order, or let two agents settle. Only the Ant CEO has spent ~40 yuan. Everyone else is stuck at browse. Merchants and users wait on each other. Mastercard writes KYA so the network, not the model, carries the chargeback. OPPO's Xiaobu 2x is the early GMV print off a small base. Alibaba science is still in the decide-not-pay camp. 6–12 months is a speech, not a backend curve. Keep the method weekly: name the bottleneck (bandwidth, exam hours, token bill, trust, weather window) and only then pick the ticker. Numbers on this tape beat category slides. If the guest cannot price the unit — tokens, tasks, hectares, or a 40-yuan checkout — the mark is a story, not a position.
mental_model.application: BABA is Zhou plus the Alibaba graph behind agent shopping. MA is the KYA / machine-rail print. Ant is private. Do not underwrite agentic GMV from a 40-yuan snack and a 2x on a tiny Xiaobu base. Diligence who eats the fraud when the agent is wrong. Forty yuan and a 2x on Xiaobu do not make a GMV curve. KYA is the product because chargebacks trained the last generation to type a card. Until the network eats the bad agent, checkout stays a demo.

key_insights.question: Is agent checkout real?
key_insights.answer: Han spent ~40 yuan. Jorn, Liu, Zhou have not. Xiaobu purchase 2x off a small base.

key_insights.question: Why is 2026 slower than 2025Q4 slides?
key_insights.answer: Users wait for merchant agents; merchants wait for users. Ant tries to be MnO2.

key_insights.question: What is Mastercard shipping?
key_insights.answer: Know Your Agent plus intent, so chargebacks work when a bot pays. Trust, not a new model.

top_investment_implications.thesis: KYA and a machine-pay rail are the trust layer the table says is missing — medium
Zhou plus Alibaba's graph sit on the decide side; checkout is still Ant/Mastercard — low
